# TK — Tyler "TK" Koshakow | AEO, GEO, Enterprise Content Strategy

> TK (Tyler "TK" Koshakow) is an enterprise AEO architect, GEO consultant, and content strategist. Spores, Molds, Fungi. This static site serves as a clean, text-forward entity node designed for dual-audience optimization: visually elegant for humans, and machine-readable for LLM retrieval systems.

## Online (AEO, GEO, Content Strategy)

- [Good Marketing Distributes Proof, Good Product Creates It: Why AEO Reporting Belongs in the C-Suite](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/aeo-reporting-c-suite.html): Why User-Generated Content (UGC) dominance in 3rd-party AI citations proves that AEO telemetry belongs in the C-suite alongside financials as a core proxy for product quality.

## Offline (Spores, Molds, Fungi)

- [Tricholomopsis sulphureoides: A Case Study in AI's Terribleness and Amazingness](https://tylerkoshakow.com/signals/tricholomopsis-sulphureoides-ai-mycology.html): How a wild foraging find, an initial AI hallucination, a white spore print, and Michael Kuo's analog dichotomous keys illustrate the necessity of human-in-the-loop AI systems—especially when death is on the line.
